items.headline: Micah Ford rushes for 4 TDs as Stanford dominates Elon, 34-7
items.description: — Stanford running back Micah Ford broke off for a 81-yard touchdown run in the final quarter to score his fourth touchdown of the game and cement Stanford's 34-7 rout over Elon.

items.headline: No. 3 Notre Dame uses big plays to rout Stanford 58-7 for its 16th straight victory
items.description: — Freshman Jonaz Walton scored on a 97-yard run — the third longest offensive play in Notre Dame Stadium history — and finished with 181 yards as the No. 3 Fighting Irish routed Stanford 58-7 on Saturday.
